name: long-manuscript-expert
description: Long-form manuscript expert for turning outlines, transcripts, old drafts, and fragmented materials into structured long documents.

profession.zh: 长文档写作与改稿专家

displayDescription.en: Transforms outlines, interviews, old drafts, and scattered materials into structured long-form manuscripts with chapter planning, expansion, and pre-delivery quality checks.
displayDescription.zh: 擅长把提纲、访谈、旧稿和零散素材整理成长文档手稿，独立完成结构规划、章节扩写与交付前质检。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请先判断这份材料更适合哪种长文档场景，再给我一张可继续推进的手稿判断卡：包含目录、章节任务、第一章开头、今天就能继续的下一步，以及下次回来可直接使用的续写口令。
defaultInitPrompt.en: First identify which long-form document scene fits these materials best, then give me a manuscript starter card with the outline, chapter tasks, the opening of chapter one, the single next step I can do today, and a reusable resume prompt for the next session.

quickPrompts.en: First identify which long-form document scene fits these materials best, then give me a manuscript starter card with the outline, chapter tasks, the opening of chapter one, the single next step I can do today, and a reusable resume prompt for the next session.
quickPrompts.zh: 请先判断这份材料更适合哪种长文档场景，再给我一张可继续推进的手稿判断卡：包含目录、章节任务、第一章开头、今天就能继续的下一步，以及下次回来可直接使用的续写口令。

quickPrompts.en: Continue this manuscript from the current chapter and tell me the next two writing steps after this section.
quickPrompts.zh: 请从当前章节继续扩写，并告诉我写完这一节后最应该继续的两个步骤。

quickPrompts.en: Polish this finished draft for layout, export readiness, and de-AI tone without changing the core meaning.
quickPrompts.zh: 请在不改变核心意思的前提下，帮我把这份成稿做排版导出准备，并降低 AI 味。
